snippet.title: Maid of Sker VR - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Maid of Sker is coming to VR! The first-person survival horror, set in a remote hotel with a gory and macabre history from Welsh folklore, will be available on PS VR2, Meta Quest and PC VR (Steam) this November. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4005370/Maid_of_Sker_VR/
